notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
It has come to my attention that different qualities make Hero move slower or faster, so if you are noticing that you are too slow in game, go to the settings and change to a lower quality. Ill try and find a fix

Also if you are getting an error that your game cant be started, you will have to disable Unreal Engine firewalls from your antivirus. I cannot disable the firewall ( That I know of )

notes.title: Horrors of the Ocean
notes.content:
This is an update ive been planning since the very very early days of development, however planning didn't start until 2 months ago. We added a new side quest line for Scylla and Charybdis!

Scylla and Charybdis are my favorite story from greek mythology, ever since I saw them in the Odyssey. So naturally I HAD to add them, and so I did!

The quest line can first begin after you defeat the dragon of life. In carper town an old captain is interested in taking on the Sea Monsters Scylla and Charybdis! Will you join him, or leave the monsters alone?

Along with the new quest line, I added a special super powerful weapon : Scyllas Fang!

Hopefully you guys enjoy playing the quest as much as I did making it! 

On top of the Scylla Charybdis quest line, in Carper town right in front of the players house is a lovely little Christmas tree, in celebration of the upcoming holidays. From December 25th - 31st, you can get special Christmas gifts from the tree!

Enjoy the update everyone! And Happy Holidays! 
             - Lightsaber09 from Gigsjaw

notes.title: Bug Fixes + Additional Content
notes.content:
First things changed were some bugs, including :
When getting into a fight with a Distantia Fallen knight, the game would softlock

Made it so you can no longer save in the broken town, because that caused camera issues.

New Enemy! Soul Collector ( Unlocked after starting one of the new sidequests in Distantia forest )

notes.title: Spaaaaaace
notes.content:
Added a new area : Distantia Forest - Forest of Space

With Distantia forest I wanted to give the feeling of it being longer and more confusing than it is, which I believe I absolutely nailed! 
Distantia Forest includes :

A new town with a special side quest
A dungeon ( as always )
A funny little area with a sneak peek of some characters my sister and I created
The castle of space ( of course )
And a travelling merchant who offers random goodies for a hefty price

Update also includes :
Fast travel! Once you kill the dragon of space, you gain the ability to fast travel through Kenestria!

I hope you guys enjoy the update, and I'll see you all in the next one!

notes.title: Magic Update
notes.content:
Added a new weapon type "Staves", which also come with a new weapon stat / enchantment. 
Staves have spell damage added to them, which  increase how much damage spells do.
The Magic enchantment also increases the damage that spells do.

Next items to be added will most likely be armor centered around magic users.

notes.title: Storage Box Update ( V11 )
notes.content: The world of Kenestria now has multiple storage boxes scattered around. The storage box can hold 25 items, and all storage boxes have a shared inventory.  The Red side with a down arrow deposits items, where the blue side with an up arrow withdraws items.

notes.title: Update V5
notes.content:
Added new Skill tree system, as you level up you gain skill points that you can put into 1 of 4 trees to level up stats such as defense, attack, or gain skills to help turn the tide of battle. 

! IF YOU ALREADY ARE LEVELED UP IN THE GAME, RESET YOUR SKILL TREE TO GET THE LOST SKILL POINTS !

Skill trees : 

Strength - adds Attack

Dexterity - adds Crit + Attack Speed

Constitution - adds Defense and Resistance 

Intelligence - adds MP Regen and Spell Damage

Small fixes :

Fixed a few areas you could get stuck or leave the designated play area ( Harpoons on dock, gap in the dock, small area in the carper town wall )

! IF YOU ALREADY ARE LEVELED UP IN THE GAME, RESET YOUR SKILL TREE TO GET THE LOST SKILL POINTS !
